description:
Functieomschrijving

Tender Engineer Civil

Solliciteer nu

Terug naar overzicht

Blink jij uit in analytische taken en houd je van het becijferen van civiele werken zoals bruggen, tunnels,...? Zijn optimalisaties onderzoeken en uitvoeren helemaal je ding? Kan je een mondje meepraten met de werf- en projectleiders? Dan ben jij misschien wel dé calculator die wij zoeken.

Informatie Vergaring Om De Juiste Prijs Te Kunnen Berekenen

  • Bijwonen of organiseren van de nodige vergaderingen.
  • Nauw samenwerken met directe collega’s en andere betrokken interne afdelingen.
  • Contacten onderhouden met de bouwheer, studiebureaus, tot en met de bestelling.

Kostprijsberekening Van Projecten

  • Bestuderen en analyseren van lastenboeken, plannen en meetstaten.
  • Het samenstellen van de kostprijs in het calculatieprogramma, KPD BouwOffice, o.b.v. offertes van onderaannemers en leveranciers, het rendement van eigen werken en de werfkosten.
  • Afstemmen met interne afdelingen inzake planning, uitvoeringsmethoden en kwaliteitseisen, ter optimalisatie van de kostprijs en de uitvoeringstermijn en ter voorbereiding op het uitvoeren van het project.
  • Afstemmen van het administratieve lastenboek met interne experten en het verwerken van hun feedback.

Offerte En Gunningsfase

  • Na het bepalen van de definitieve prijs zorgen voor de uitgaande offerte met benodigde overzichten en bijlagen.
  • Controleren van de contractuele documenten bij bestelling, waaronder de technische items t.o.v. de aanbestedingsdocumenten.
  • Organiseren van de correcte overdracht van het gewonnen project aan het aangeduide werfteam.

Jouw profiel

  • Ben je in het bezit van een diploma bouwkundig ingenieur of gelijkaardigs? Top! Heb je daarnaast al meerdere jaren ervaring als calculator bij een grote aannemer? Dan kom je zeker in aanmerking!
  • Ervaringen met KPD BouwOffice en MS Project zijn alvast een pluspunt.
  • Je denkt pro-actief en out of the box na. Problemen analyseren vind je de leukste uitdaging!
  • Je gaat steeds planmatig en georganiseerd te werk. Geen enkel detail is je ontgaan.
  • Je bent een echte teamspeler, maar kan ook als de beste anderen overtuigen in discussies met stevige argumenten.
  • Nieuwe trends en ontwikkelingen ontdek jij als eerste. Je zoekt naar informatie en wil constant bijleren.
  • Je bent Nederlandstalig en kan je ook uitdrukken in het Frans en Engels.
  • Je bent bereid om vanop ons kantoor in Neder-Over-Heembeek, Sint-Truiden of Eke te werken, waarbij je ook de kans krijgt om regelmatig thuis te werken.

Ons aanbod

Bij STADSBADER CONTRACTORS kom je terecht in een mensgerichte organisatie, waar collegialiteit en openheid centraal zijn. Je doorloopt een degelijk onboardingproces zodat je jouw intern netwerk vlot kunt uitbouwen. Jouw team gaat er steeds voor de volle 100% voor. Daarnaast is er ook ruimte voor ontspanning. We bieden jou een aantrekkelijke verloning en een uitgebreid pakket aan extralegale voordelen.

Bedrijfsvoorstelling

STADSBADER CONTRACTORS nv behoort tot de belangrijkste Belgische aannemingsbedrijven op de Vlaamse en Brusselse markt en maakt deel uit van STADSBADER Group. Dag in, dag uit geven onze medewerkers vorm aan een betere leefomgeving. Daar staat ook onze baseline voor: Together we create space. Dit maken we waar dankzij de realisatie van spoorwerken, wegenwerken, tunnels en bruggen die de veiligheid en mobiliteit van de weggebruiker verhogen, en industriële projecten die bijdragen aan de economische welvaart. Met deze expertises profileren we ons ook als dé uitgelezen partner in de realisatie van omvangrijke en complexe projecten. Onze landelijke dekking stelt ons bovendien in staat om zowel onze publieke als private klanten een nabije dienstverlening te garanderen. Multidisciplinair, duurzaam en betrouwbaar, dat is STADSBADER CONTRACTORS.

title: Executivo (a) de Vendas – Renovações
description:
Job Description A Transformação Digital está levando empresas a migrar suas operações para a nuvem e a adotar serviços de colaboração e produtividade online. Trabalhar desde diferentes lugares se tornou normal, com funcionários remotos ou dividindo o tempo entre o escritório e outros lugares. Com a aceleração da adoção de soluções em nuvem, a transformação digital levou poucos meses para realizar o que se previa acontecer em anos. O cenário do trabalho remoto destacou a importância da nuvem para a continuidade dos negócios através de colaboração eficiente e segurança. Ao manter operações baseadas na nuvem, as empresas poderão fazer mais do que manter seu status quo. Uma empresa poderá escalar sem esforço, explorar mais oportunidades de negócios e aumentar a segurança. Faça com que uma empresa alcance o futuro já.

Em nosso time de vendas nós acreditamos nesta visão. A Oracle está liderando a revolução digital. Estamos capacitando quase meio milhão de empresas em todo o mundo para transformar potencial inexplorado em valor comercial real. Você conectará as maiores empresas de hoje com as ferramentas para competir na economia digital de amanhã.

O Perfil da vaga é focado na renovação e gerenciamento de contas nomeadas existentes. O papel consiste em atividade proativa para a renovação e retenção de clientes, bem como potencialmente identificar oportunidades de upsell para clientes existentes. O cargo é fundamental para gerenciar a base de clientes existente e requer habilidades em vendas, definição de estratégia de renovação e tomada de decisão independente. A função será medida principalmente na retenção de receita de clientes existentes por meio de atividades de renovação. A pessoa para ter sucesso nesta vaga precisa ter uma sólida experiência em vendas, excelente visão de negócios com fortes habilidades interpessoais e de apresentação e compromisso com o sucesso do cliente.

A pessoa que ocupa esta vaga precisa ser apaixonada por tendências tecnológicas para construir relações de longo prazo e com foco no cliente. Faz isso em um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com criação de confiança entre todas as partes envolvidas.

Responsibilities

  • Garantir as renovações dos contratos de subscrição no respectivo território assignado;
  • Gerenciar as demandas da base de clientes Oracle NetSuite, incluindo gestão de satisfação do cliente e acompanhamento nos projetos de implantação;
  • Educar os clientes sobre as práticas de negócios e quaisquer implicações contratuais associadas;
  • Desenvolver parcerias sólidas com os clientes, cultivando um relacionamento de confiança com foco na construção de uma percepção positiva de valor mútua;
  • Construir e identificar oportunidades de upsell na base instalada por meio de sessões de revisão de processos e sessões técnicas;
  • Negociar com sucesso todas as questões relacionadas a renovações;
  • Ser uma pessoa com perfil consultivo e influenciadora confiável na tomada de decisões do cliente para comprar, arquitetar e adotar o melhor uso do Oracle NetSuite;
  • Desenvolver e manter o conhecimento técnico consistente de alto nível do produto, contratos, atualizações de versões e preços;
  • Atingir metas de renovações mensais, trimestrais e anuais nos clientes e território assignado;
  • Alcançar e manter a meta de taxa de retenção dos clientes assignados.

Requisitos e habilidades necessárias

  • Capacidade de navegar efetivamente por objeções e desafios em direção a um resultado positivo de renovação;
  • Experiência em vendas de soluções de gestão empresarial;
  • Relacionamento com clientes e acompanhamento em gestão de projetos;
  • Gestão de satisfação de cliente;
  • Habilidade em construir e colaborar resultados em equipe;
  • Inglês Avançado.

Requisitos e habilidades desejáveis

  • Conhecimento de processos de negócios de gestão empresarial (ERP);
  • Espanhol Avançado.

Diferenciais

Uma carreira na Oracle é definida por você. Damos a você a liberdade – e as habilidades – para escrever sua própria história de sucesso. Seja qual for o caminho que você seguir, você obterá experiências de aprendizado inestimáveis e será apoiado para fazer seu melhor trabalho.

title: Product Manager
description:
Sobre a vaga

O(a) Product Manager será responsável por liderar a estratégia, desenvolvimento e entrega de produtos e funcionalidades de alto impacto. Atuará como ponte entre stakeholders, clientes e times técnicos, garantindo que a visão do produto esteja alinhada aos objetivos de negócio e às necessidades dos usuários.

  • Liderar equipes multifuncionais, oferecendo orientação e garantindo a entrega bem-sucedida de funcionalidades.
  • Construir e gerenciar roadmaps de produto, alinhando-os às metas estratégicas e prioridades dos stakeholders.
  • Representar a voz do cliente, identificando dores e propondo soluções centradas no usuário.
  • Colaborar com engenharia, design, ciência de dados e times comerciais para definir requisitos e entregar valor.
  • Utilizar dados e métricas para embasar decisões, criar business cases e medir resultados.
  • Escrever requisitos detalhados e user stories para comunicação clara com o time de desenvolvimento.
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis, incluindo planejamento de sprints, retrospectivas e reviews.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products and services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients – in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. We share an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy, and Ledn’s suite of products and services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction makes Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full‑time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud‐based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate has demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security‑first environments and is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. The role also requires strong customer‑support skills and a willingness to help end users who need assistance.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud‑first infrastructure and networks. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.

About The Role

You will be customer‑facing and the first line of support, owning support and providing an outstanding support experience to our employees via Slack, Jira, etc. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise.

  • Procuring and delivering technology equipment.
  • Owning the experience of tech onboarding for all new employees and tech retrieval for all outgoing employees.
  • Designing, testing, building, and documenting programs, policies and tools, and contributing improvements to existing knowledge.
  • Supporting and managing SaaS applications – Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • Managing Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools – MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.
  • Improving IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) and automating busywork.
  • Managing, responding to and fixing critical incidents and issues through to completion.

You will work on projects over sprints, detail your work in tools like Jira (you are experienced with agile methods and sprints), and set and work toward your own objectives and key results with minimal direction while aligning them to the team and company goals.

What You Bring To Ledn

7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.

Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc., and to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.

Experience integrating SSO into Okta, creating workflows in Okta, working with APIs, and integrating systems.

Remote support experience across multiple time zones, familiarity with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.

Strong communication skills, clear writing, and a desire to provide a magical experience for others.

Security awareness (e.g., PGP) and networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching).

Self‑management, strong organizational and task‑management skills, and the ability to handle ambiguity.

Nice To Haves

Some familiarity with AWS; use of tools like GAM and command‑line interfaces.

Jamf, Okta, and Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

Leadership with resilience, adaptability, and a builder’s mindset.

Collaborative partner with empathy and clarity.

Demonstrated integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse cultural contexts.

Experience working in a remote environment.

A Taste Of What We Provide

Comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day.

Competitive PTO package ensuring you have the time off you deserve.

Ownership in the company through shared equity.

Opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).

Clear purpose and support that removes barriers so you love what you do.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. For accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process, requests will be addressed confidentially.

Building the Future of Crypto

Our Krakenites are a world-class team with crypto conviction, united by our desire to discover and unlock the potential of crypto and blockchain technology.

What makes us different?

Kraken is a mission-focused company rooted in crypto values. As a Krakenite, you’ll join us on our mission to accelerate the global adoption of crypto, so that everyone can achieve financial freedom and inclusion. For over a decade, Kraken’s focus on our mission and crypto ethos has attracted many of the most talented crypto experts in the world.

Before you apply, please read the Kraken Culture page to learn more about our internal culture, values, and mission. We also expect candidates to familiarize themselves with the Kraken app. Learn how to create a Kraken account here.

As a fully remote company, we have Krakenites in 70+ countries who speak over 50 languages. Krakenites are industry pioneers who develop premium crypto products for experienced traders, institutions, and newcomers to the space. Kraken is committed to industry-leading security, crypto education, and world-class client support through our products like Kraken Pro, Desktop, Wallet, and Kraken Futures.

Become a Krakenite and build the future of crypto!

Proof of work

The team

We’re hiring Data Analysts to join our Compliance Enterprise Client Data Office team, working remotely from India! This role is centered on building and enhancing compliance dashboarding, analytics, and insights — the core responsibility of the position. The candidate must be passionate about creating dashboards that deliver clear, actionable insights, as this will be the main focus of the role.

As a Data Analyst, you will own core responsibilities such as designing scalable compliance dashboards, analytics, and metrics, architecting automated pipelines and audit-ready regulatory reports, and translating plain-language business or regulatory requests into precise data models. You’ll partner closely with leaders across Compliance, Risk, and other stakeholders to strengthen our compliance posture and ensure regulators and executives have visibility into accurate, meaningful insights. Your ability to contextualize data within the broader business and risk landscape, and communicate those insights to both technical and non-technical audiences, will be essential.

In addition to these core responsibilities, you will also provide ad-hoc support where needed: managing data requests, assisting with regulatory reporting, supporting automation and peer code reviews, and developing tactical solutions that free up Product and Engineering teams to focus on long-term improvements. The ability to juggle multiple projects simultaneously, communicate effectively in a fully remote environment, and leverage AI to create scalable frameworks will be key to success.

Ultimately, this is a critical role shaping Kraken’s compliance and client data strategy, aligning data practices with ambitious business objectives, and navigating the complexities of an evolving regulatory landscape with rigor, creativity, and precision.

The opportunity

  • Develop and maintain high-quality data sources in partnership with Data and Engineering teams.

  • Build key datasets and data pipelines using Python and ETL frameworks (e.g., Airflow).

  • Design and automate reports, dashboards, and compliance metrics ensuring consistency, accuracy, and actionable insights for business partners across the business.

  • Work closely with Regional Compliance Officers to deliver audit-ready regulatory reports.

  • Build client data dashboards for Executive Leadership, providing insights on trends, KPIs, demographics, and growth opportunities.

  • Monitor and improve client data quality by identifying issues, driving remediations, and coordinating timely resolutions.

  • Automate compliance governance controls and monitoring to ensure processes operate as expected.

  • Provide cross-functional support during peak periods (requirements definition, backlog management, QA triage) to maintain delivery timelines.

  • Develop ad-hoc compliance solutions to enable Product Development and Engineering teams to focus on long-term improvements.

  • Support ad-hoc data requests for audits, exams, risk assessments, and day-to-day business needs.

Skills you should HODL

  • 3+ years industry experience in data analysis and data management

  • 2+ years experience in Compliance and Regulatory Reporting areas

  • Advanced knowledge of SQL, scripting languages and database concepts with a record of performing data analysis using a scripting language

  • Expert in Python for data analysis, automation, and building scalable applications, with high proficiency in libraries, frameworks, and scripting for complex workflows

  • Hands-on experience with, AWS, Airflow, Cursor, and BI tools such as QuickSight or Superset

  • Experience using compliance and investigation tools (e.g., Hummingbird, Moody’s RDC, Chainalysis, Elliptic) to support regulatory reporting, monitoring, and risk analysis.

  • Ability to synthesize ambiguous regulatory requests into technical requirements

  • Familiarity with data warehouse development and best practices

  • Ability to clearly present reports, dashboards and complex results to Executives

  • You believe wholeheartedly in the cypherpunk, libertarian values outlined in Kraken’s Tentaclements document.

  • Must be based in India and fluent in English

Nice to Haves

  • Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related technical field.

  • Knowledge of AML/FCC, Sanctions, KYC, MiCA, MiFID, or Data Governance regulations.

  • Passionate about crypto with deep knowledge of emerging trends and tokens beyond blue chips

Crescimento profissional incomparável

Aproveite as oportunidades de trabalhar em projetos diversificados e de alto impacto, incluindo avaliações de liderança e serviços de consultoria de RH, em uma empresa comprometida com a excelência, o sucesso do cliente e o desenvolvimento de longo prazo dos funcionários.

Política de Igualdade de Oportunidades de Emprego e Não Discriminação

Declaração de Igualdade de Oportunidades de Emprego:

Tanto a Keller quanto seus clientes são empregadores que oferecem igualdade de oportunidades. Para todas as vagas, os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para o emprego, independentemente de raça, cor da pele, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, nacionalidade, idade, estado civil, deficiência, gravidez, informaçõesGenéticas ou qualquer outra condição protegida pela legislação trabalhista brasileira ou outras leis aplicáveis.

Compromisso com a Diversidade:

Tanto a Keller quanto seus clientes estão comprometidos em promover ambientes de trabalho diversificados e inclusivos, onde todos os indivíduos são valorizados e respeitados. Acreditamos que a diversidade impulsiona a inovação e o sucesso e nos esforçamos para criar locais de trabalho onde todos possam prosperar.

Acomodações razoáveis:

Tanto a Keller quanto seus clientes estão comprometidos em fornecer acomodações razoáveis para pessoas com deficiência ou grávidas, em conformidade com as leis trabalhistas brasileiras. Nos envolvemos em um processo interativo para identificar acomodações eficazes para garantir acesso igualitário às oportunidades de emprego.

Informações sobre remuneração:

As informações sobre salários e remuneração serão disponibilizadas durante o processo de entrevista, de acordo com as regulamentações trabalhistas locais. Quando necessário, as faixas salariais serão incluídas nas vagas anunciadas. As ofertas salariais reais podem variar de acordo com as habilidades, experiência e estruturas salariais aplicáveis.

Conformidade com as leis:

Tanto a Keller quanto seus clientes cumprem todas as leis trabalhistas brasileiras aplicáveis relativas à não discriminação no emprego. Esta política se aplica a todos os termos e condições de emprego, incluindo recrutamento, contratação, colocação, promoção, rescisão, demissão, recontratação, transferência, licenças, remuneração e treinamento.

Assédio no local de trabalho:

Tanto a Keller quanto seus clientes proíbem expressamente qualquer forma de assédio ou discriminação no local de trabalho com base em raça, cor da pele, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, nacionalidade, idade, informação genética, deficiência ou qualquer outro status protegido pela legislação brasileira. Estamos comprometidos em manter ambientes de trabalho seguros e respeitosos para todos os funcionários.

Privacidade e equidade salarial:

Tanto a Keller quanto seus clientes se dedicam à equidade salarial e revisam periodicamente as práticas de remuneração para garantir a justiça e a conformidade com as leis aplicáveis. A privacidade dos funcionários é respeitada e todos os dados pessoais serão tratados de acordo com as leis brasileiras de proteção de dados, como a Lei de Proteção de Dados Pessoais.

Status de veterano e serviço nacional:

Tanto a Keller quanto seus clientes oferecem oportunidades iguais de emprego a veteranos e cumprem as leis relacionadas às preferências de emprego para indivíduos que cumpriram suas obrigações de serviço nacional.

title: Strategic Account Executive Remote - Brazil
description:
At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Strategic Account Executive.

About the job

Twilio is looking for an Account Executive to join our strategic sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and closing new business opportunities, building strategic relationships, and helping innovative companies unlock the full potential of Twilio’s communication platform.

You will work closely with internal teams (Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing, etc.) to understand client needs and deliver customized solutions that drive real business value. This is a high-impact role for a driven, strategic, and highly collaborative salesperson.

Responsibilities

  • Drive new, upselling business revenue by identifying, qualifying, and closing high-impact opportunities with enterprise customers.
  • Own the entire sales cycle — from prospecting to negotiation and closing — with a focus on strategic and consultative selling.
  • Understand customer needs and business drivers to position Twilio’s platform and APIs as transformative solutions.
  • Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key stakeholders, including C-level executives, technical leaders, and business decision-makers.
  • Collaborate with Solutions Engineers, Product, Marketing, and technical teams to design and deliver value-added solutions.
  • Develop account plans, territory strategies, and accurate sales forecasts to achieve and exceed revenue targets.
  • Navigate complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and buying centers.
  • Continuously learn and stay informed about Twilio’s evolving product suite and industry trends to better serve clients.
  • Represent Twilio at industry events, conferences, and meetings to build pipeline and elevate brand awareness.
  • Champion the voice of the customer internally to help shape future product enhancements and go-to-market strategies.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in B2B sales, preferably in the SaaS, cloud communications, or enterprise software industries.
  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding sales quotas and driving multi-million dollar deals.
  • Experience selling complex solutions to technical and business stakeholders at the enterprise level.
  • Strong consultative selling skills and ability to develop tailored value propositions for strategic accounts.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Comfortable navigating complex organizations and influencing cross-functional teams (e.g., product, marketing, engineering).
  • Deep understanding of the sales cycle, including prospecting, qualifying, forecasting, and closing.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and high-growth environment.
  • Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM tools to manage pipelines and forecast revenue.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to understand customer pain points and industry trends.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or technical background is a plus.
  • Fluency in English
  • CPaaS experience
  • ISV and B2B2B or B2B2C experience
  • CX experience
  • B2B/SaaS Sales: Demonstrated success in selling cloud-based solutions, SaaS, or similar technologies
  • Proven Results: Track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales targets.

Location

This role will be Remote, and based in São Paulo, Brazil.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

description:
Analista de Qualidade de Software Pleno

Trabalho Remoto Efetivo

Descrição da vaga: Mais do que simples fornecedores de tecnologia, nos destacamos como verdadeiros especialistas em logística. Nossas soluções são moldadas pela vasta experiência que acumulamos ao longo dos anos, refletindo a sabedoria e os aprendizados adquiridos ao longo de nossa jornada. É essa expertise que nos capacita a oferecer uma abordagem personalizada e altamente eficaz para cada cliente. Por mais de 25 anos, trabalhamos com operações logísticas de grande escala, servindo a uma variedade de setores, incluindo indústrias, varejistas, operadores logísticos e transportadoras. Mantendo um olhar perspicaz sobre as tendências do mercado, desenvolvemos sistemas adaptáveis que se ajustam às necessidades em constante evolução de nossos clientes. Nossa trajetória de pioneirismo ao longo dos últimos anos nos proporcionou um amplo know‑how e expertise em todas as nuances do setor logístico. Essa jornada nos permitiu acumular valiosa experiência e nos destacar como líderes em oferecer as melhores práticas do mercado. Além de nosso conhecimento aprofundado, a segurança é uma prioridade essencial para nós. Somos certificados pela ISO/IEC 27001, garantindo que adotemos os mais rigorosos padrões em segurança da informação, demonstrando nosso compromisso com a proteção de nossos parceiros e clientes.

Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados e determinados para se juntarem a nós como Analista de Qualidade. Se você tem vontade de aprender, transformar a logística e mobilidade e fazer a diferença, essa é a sua oportunidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Planejar, criar e executar testes manuais, garantindo que os sistemas atendam aos requisitos funcionais e técnicos.
  • Identificar, registrar e acompanhar defeitos, garantindo sua resolução em conjunto com o time de desenvolvimento.
  • Colaborar ativamente com equipes de desenvolvimento e negócio, aplicando comunicação clara e análise crítica na definição de requisitos e critérios de aceitação.
  • Assegurar a confiabilidade, performance e usabilidade das soluções entregues, contribuindo para a satisfação do usuário e redução de falhas em produção.
  • Contribuir na automação de testes, assegurando qualidade contínua e evolução consistente do produto.
  • Participar das cerimônias ágeis (daily, planning, review, retrospectiva), trazendo visão crítica e foco em melhoria contínua.
  • Contribuir com a definição e padronização de processos de QA, disseminando boas práticas de qualidade.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência sólida como QA em processos de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Experiência em teste manual e automatizado como: criação, manutenção, execução e análise de resultados.
  • Experiência em testes de API.
  • Conhecimento com Frameworks como Selenium, Cypress, Playwright ou similares.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL para validação de dados).
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (ex: Scrum, Kanban).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de tarefas e bugs (ex.: ClickUp, Azure DevOps, Jira, Trello ou similares).
  • Excelente interpretação e escrita de textos técnicos.
  • Postura ética no manuseio de dados e na comunicação de resultados.

Diferenciais

  • Formação na área de TI (Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, ADS ou similares).
  • Escrita de testes utilizando Gherkin.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas fiscais eletrônicos (CT‑e, NF‑e, MDF‑e, SPED) é um diferencial, mas não é requisito obrigatório.
  • Conhecimentos em lógica de programação (JavaScript, C#).

Informações adicionais

No KMM by nstech, temos uma cultura baseada em valores e esperamos que todos os nstechers não apenas se identifiquem, mas também vivam essa cultura em seu dia a dia. Acreditamos que a cultura é uma das maiores vantagens competitivas para negócios bem‑sucedidos, pois é algo que não pode ser copiado integralmente.

Nossos pilares culturais e seus atributos são:

  • Servir: foco no cliente, humildade, transparência e ética.
  • Equipe: valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a vontade de colocar a mão na massa e o espírito colaborativo.
  • Resultados: buscamos agilidade, melhoria contínua, geração de valor a longo prazo e foco nos resultados.

Por que fazer parte da nstech?

Temos a visão de ser a plataforma de tecnologia para logística e mobilidade que conecta os elos e gera mais valor para os negócios da rede integrada de logística da América Latina. Atualmente, contamos com uma equipe de mais de 5 mil nstechers comprometidos em melhorar o mundo por meio da tecnologia aplicada à logística e mobilidade. Estamos empenhados em gerar impacto para a sociedade, clientes, colaboradores e acionistas, e queremos somar forças com pessoas cheias de energia e propósito para fazer parte da nossa equipe e dessa transformação.

Essa oportunidade é remoto . A vaga é para contratação CLT, com todos os benefícios dessa modalidade:

  • Plano de saúde com baixa coparticipação.
  • Convênio odontológico totalmente custeado pela empresa.
  • Seguro de vida totalmente custeado pela empresa.
  • Benefício flexível para refeições ou alimentação.
  • Gympass e Zenklub para atividades físicas e bem‑estar mental.
  • Dia de folga no aniversário.

Etapas do processo

  • Etapa 1: Cadastro.
  • Etapa 2: Triagem.
  • Etapa 3: Entrevista com Gente e Gestão.
  • Etapa 4: Entrevista com Head da área.
  • Etapa 5: Carta Proposta.
  • Etapa 6: Contratação.

Junte-se a nós!

Somos nstech, a mais completa plataforma open logistics do mundo e estamos construindo o futuro digital do transporte de cargas junto a todo o ecossistema logístico. Nosso objetivo é impactar a sociedade de forma positiva, reduzindo a poluição, o trânsito, as mortes nas estradas e os custos logísticos. Atendemos países como Brasil, EUA, México, Colômbia, Peru, Equador, Bolívia, Chile, Argentina, Portugal, Angola, e continuamos expandindo nosso impacto pelo mundo. Venha fazer parte da construção do futuro da logística e mobilidade!

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!
Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future.
We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world.
Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients — in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds.
What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so.
The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy.
Combining these values with our conviction makes Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better.
Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full‑time Manager of IT.
The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud‑based IT systems and tools.
A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security‑first environments.
The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code.
But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks.
You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever‑changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment.
You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast‑moving and highly execution‑oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.

About the Role

This role will report to the Director of IT. You will be customer‑facing, and the first line of support; you own support and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac.
You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You’ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.). You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.
Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You’re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilise open‑source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Do you integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You’ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you’re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time‑poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it’s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone’s time.
  • You can self‑manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task‑management skills are critical.
  • You’re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.)
  • You’ve used tools like GAM and command‑line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.
The ideal candidate will:
• Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.
• Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
• Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
• Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
• Have worked in a remote environment before.
• Taste of What We Provide.

What We Provide

As one of the world’s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. A comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company.
Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.
You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process.
Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Working Environment

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.
We are a remote first environment. Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted.
As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please.
We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Dividido entre as frentes de Branding, Revenue Operations e Estratégia de Comunicação, nosso time atua com o objetivo de impulsionar a visibilidade e o posicionamento da marca, promovendo os imóveis que gerenciamos e também os novos empreendimentos que vendemos a preço de custo. Mais do que isso, somos responsáveis por desenvolver e fortalecer a identidade da Seazone, garantindo que nossa essência esteja presente em cada ponto de contato com o público. Como Especialista de Product Marketing , esse cargo será responsável por posicionar, comunicar e impulsionar a adoção de produtos ou serviços, garantindo que o mercado compreenda claramente o valor da solução e que as equipes internas (comercial, marketing e produto) estejam alinhadas sobre sua proposta de valor.

Muito prazer, nós somos a Cia. Tradicional de Comércio! Estamos há mais de 25 anos no mercado com o objetivo de ser a melhor empresa de entretenimento gastronômico casual do Brasil. Dar suporte aos garçons no processo de atendimento ao cliente.

description:
Brand & Marketing Designer (Part-Time / Fractional)

We’re building a differentiated brand in a brutally competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a "make it pretty" gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics.

What You'll Do

  • Own day-to-day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product-adjacent surfaces.
  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion-ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one-pagers).
  • Collaborate on campaign concepts end-to-end: insight → moodboard → concept → production → iteration.
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self-serve.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought-leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS.
  • Asset turnaround under 48 h for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near-zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands-on design experience in SaaS / AI (agency or in-house).
  • You know the category patterns and how to break them.
  • Exceptional taste. Refined typography, layout discipline, restraint where it matters, edge where it counts.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; references at your fingertips.
  • Not afraid to be bold. You can defend strong creative while staying coachable.
  • Fast-paced, passionate, easy to work with. Low-ego collaborator who communicates crisply.
  • Tools: Figma & WordPress / Elementor power user; Adobe Illustrator as needed.
  • Bonus if you can add light motion (After Effects, or Figma video exports).

Bonus Points

  • Have 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Can produce quick micro-motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understand performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb-stop, offer framing, mobile-first).
  • Have experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

  • Start part-time freelance; earn your way into a full-time seat in 12 months through results.
  • Ship work that's seen by millions, not buried in decks.
  • Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.

What to Include

  • Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, LPs, campaign sets, brand work).
  • For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal – your role – outcome (metrics if possible).
  • Short note on brands you admire in AI/SaaS and why (2–3 bullets).
  • Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.

Somos aliados do médico durante toda a sua jornada e buscamos por pessoas que se identifiquem com nosso propósito, valores e cultura para se juntarem ao nosso time. Vamos juntos transformar a saúde com quem tem a medicina como vocação!

Ao assumir o cargo de Consultor de Vendas na Afya, tem como objetivo principal realizar o atendimento dos leads gerados, buscando um atendimento personalizado contribuindo para uma experiência positiva dos nossos clientes.

  • Realizar o atendimento dos leads gerados, com acolhimento, cordialidade e empatia. Preferencialmente via telefone e pelos demais canais de comunicação utilizados na empresa (para atendimento da solicitação do aluno para realização da venda);

  • Estar atualizado com a estratégica da concorrência
  • Agir em conformidade aos requisitos legais e adaptação as normas internas, por meio da participação efetiva nos treinamentos e relato de possíveis desafios, zelando pelo sigilo das informações, conforme código de ética Afya e LGPD;
  • Interagir e negociar com os futuros clientes de forma personalizada (entendendo o perfil, a dor e a necessidades de cada um) adequando da melhor forma os nossos cursos de acordo com a necessidade dos clientes, visando a conversão e a satisfação dos mesmos, bem como, o atingimento das metas do setor;

  • Manter follow-up das oportunidades e contatos realizados, (através de tarefas do CRM utilizado e ferramentas do Whatsapp Business buscando maior efetividade nas vendas.

O QUE BUSCAMOS (mas não esperamos que uma única pessoa atenda a todos os requisitos):

  • Ensino médio completo , desejável cursando superior;
  • Desejável conhecimento em venda de cursos na área da educação;
  • Técnicas de negociação;
  • Técnicas de Vendas (Metodologia SPIN Selling).
  • Foco em resultados;
  • Comunicação verbal e escrita assertiva;

❤️ GENTE É O MELHOR DA GENTE, por isso, oferecemos benefícios e parcerias para o nosso time.

Para o dia a dia:

✍️ Diferencial para Professor Médico:

O MAIOR HUB DE EDUCAÇÃO E TECNOLOGIAS PARA A PRÁTICA MÉDICA DO BRASIL.

A marca Afya nasceu em 2019, mas nossa história começou muito antes. Surgimos da união entre a NRE Educacional, maior grupo de faculdades de Medicina do país, fundado em 1999, com a MEDCEL, marca de cursos preparatórios para prova de residência médica.

Com o nosso crescimento acelerado, adquirimos nos últimos anos novas unidades de ensino — já são mais de 30 espalhadas pelo Brasil — e mais de 10 startups que oferecem soluções digitais para a prática médica — Afya Whitebook, Afya iClinic, Afya Papers, Glic e Cliquefarma são algumas marcas do nosso portfólio. Acesse afya.com.br para conhecer mais sobre a nossa história e todas as soluções que oferecemos.

A Afya é uma companhia de capital aberto desde 2019, com ações negociadas na bolsa de valores Nasdaq, nos Estados Unidos. Em 2023 disponibilizamos nossas ações também na bolsa brasileira, a B3. Saiba mais sobre esse assunto em ir.afya.com .

Nosso propósito é transformar a saúde em conjunto com quem tem a medicina como vocação. About Us
Nearform is an independent team of engineers, designers, data experts and strategists who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. Responsibilities
As a Senior Python GenAI Developer at Nearform your main task will be designing & building applications using Python and GenAI tools such as Langchain. However, as you’ll likely work on a variety of projects your responsibilities may also include:

  • Supporting component design, development and maintenance and taking responsibility for personal technical quality standards within the project team.
  • Assisting with defining structured practices, especially in source code management, building and deployment.
  • Contributing to Nearform tooling and open-source projects.
  • Designing and implementing data storage solutions.
  • Optimising performance in applications for maximum speed and scalability.
  • Using appropriate tools to maintain version control and build processes.
  • Getting feedback from users and clients, and building solutions for them.
  • Assisting with the analysis of client requirements.
  • Working with and supporting the Delivery Architect (team lead) in project execution and timely delivery.
  • Collaborating with client teams.
What We Are Looking For In This Person
  • Significant experience delivering at a Senior Developer level in an enterprise environment.
  • Practical experience of delivering in an agile environment.
  • Practical experience of knowledge of developing real-world solutions and platforms.
  • Deep understanding of Python.
  • Deep understanding of SQL Databases (PostgreSQL is preferred).
  • Experience with LangChain, AutoGen, or similar frameworks for multi-agent systems.
  • Deep understanding of versioning control tools - Git in particular.
  • Good understanding of security and performance considerations.
  • Understanding of layout aesthetics, responsive design and mobile web development.
  • Understanding of architectural and design patterns.
  • General familiarity with a wide variety of open-source technologies and tools.
  • Excellent analytical and multitasking skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Professional proficiency in English.
Nice to have
  • Experience in Python and AI/ML libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn).
  • Knowledge of Data Science techniques, including data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation.
Our Interview Process
Talent Call (30 mins via Zoom)
An introductory conversation with a member of our Talent Team to learn more about your background, experience, and career goals. We'll also provide a high-level overview of Nearform and answer any questions you may have. This step helps us assess initial alignment.
Technical Assessment (1 hour via Zoom)
A live coding challenge with one of our trained interviewers. You'll be asked to build a working solution to a problem via screen sharing, demonstrating your data engineering expertise, problem-solving ability, and coding best practices in a real-time environment.
Hiring Manager Interview (45 mins via Zoom)
A conversation with a Hiring Manager focused on your approach to teamwork, client collaboration, and problem-solving in an enterprise development setting. We'll also share more details about Nearform and the potential projects you may join.
There may also be an additional interview with the client depending on the project

Apply now via our careers page at Nearform and be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.

title: Content Marketing Manager (AI & Mobile App Development)
description:
MetaCTO is a next‑generation software consultancy specializing in AI‑enabled app development and fractional CTO services . We help startups and growing companies turn visionary ideas into successful digital products. Our team builds world‑class mobile apps, backend platforms, and AI‑powered systems for clients across industries like health, education, fitness, and eCommerce.

Our work blends speed, strategy, and technical excellence . From rapid MVPs and app monetization to enterprise‑grade AI integrations, we’ve helped founders and teams move from idea to App Store in weeks—not months.

The Role

As MetaCTO’s Content Marketing Manager , you’ll own the storytelling engine that powers our brand growth. You’ll transform client wins, technical breakthroughs, and leadership insights into content that attracts leads, strengthens partnerships, and builds authority in the mobile and AI ecosystem. You’ll collaborate closely with founders, project managers, and engineers to uncover the real value behind our projects and turn it into stories that resonate with startups and product leaders worldwide.

What You’ll Do

1. Case Studies & Success Stories

  • Interview clients and engineers to capture narratives of innovation and measurable results.
  • Write 1–2 high‑quality case studies per month showcasing MetaCTO’s speed, scalability, and impact.
  • Collaborate with design and marketing to publish across MetaCTO.com, Clutch, and partner platforms.

2. Newsletters & Email Marketing

  • Plan and write monthly newsletters highlighting product launches, insights, and client stories.
  • Test subject lines, visuals, and calls‑to‑action to maximize engagement.
  • Analyze performance data and recommend improvements for future campaigns.

3. Content Strategy & Operations

  • Maintain a 90‑day content calendar covering website, email, and social channels.
  • Align content themes with MetaCTO’s strategic initiatives—AI enablement, rapid MVPs, app monetization, and platform growth.
  • Streamline workflows and templates to make content production fast and repeatable.

4. Brand & Voice Development

  • Maintain a consistent brand tone—clear, confident, and optimistic.
  • Ensure all content reflects MetaCTO’s values: clarity, speed, and technical depth.

5. Analytics & Optimization

  • Track key performance metrics and present quarterly reports on content effectiveness.
  • Identify new opportunities for SEO growth and inbound lead generation.

Key Objectives (Quarterly OKRs)

  • O1: Strengthen MetaCTO’s credibility through storytelling – Publish 4+ new case studies per quarter, increase engagement and shares, expand visibility on partner and client platforms.
  • O2: Build and engage an audience of potential clients and partners – Launch a monthly newsletter with strong engagement, grow email subscribers and LinkedIn followers, generate inbound leads through content.
  • O3: Systematize and scale content production – Establish templates and workflows, reduce leadership time on content creation by 50%.

Ideal Candidate

  • Based in Brazil , fluent in English and Portuguese .
  • 3–6 years of experience in B2B tech or agency content marketing .
  • Strong storytelling skills with the ability to translate technical achievements into business value.
  • Proven experience writing case studies, newsletters, or blog content for software or AI companies.
  • Proficiency with marketing tools (HubSpot, Notion, Google Analytics, LinkedIn).
  • Bonus: familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, Jasper) or SEO best practices.

Why Join MetaCTO

  • Collaborate directly with U.S. founders and engineers on impactful projects.
  • Remote‑first culture, flexible schedule, and creative autonomy.
  • Work with cutting‑edge technologies and tools (Claude, ChatGPT, SwiftUI, Kotlin, etc.).
  • Contribute to a company where storytelling directly drives growth and brand visibility.

Position Details

  • Type: Full‑time or Part‑time (Contract‑to‑Hire)
  • Location: 100% Remote (Brazil‑based)
  • Time Zone: Flexible with overlap for U.S. Pacific Time collaboration

How to Apply

Send your portfolio , writing samples , and a brief note on why MetaCTO’s mission inspires you to . Subject line: Content Marketing Manager (Brazil) – (Your Name)

About the Company

SuperSummary is transforming how millions of readers discover, understand, and connect with books. We're building the world's most comprehensive literature platform - combining nearly 10,000 expert-written Study Guides with interactive, innovative tools that make reading more engaging, rewarding, and fun.

Beyond summaries, our paid subscription offers chapter-by-chapter analysis, character breakdowns, themes and symbols exploration, thought-provoking discussion questions, and interactive quizzes. Our growing suite of AI-powered features helps readers engage more deeply with texts, whether they're students tackling assignments, teachers preparing lessons, book clubs seeking richer conversations, or lifelong learners exploring new genres.

About the Job

SuperSummary is looking for a seasoned, data-driven Performance Marketing Manager to own and scale our paid acquisition channels. You'll be responsible for driving efficient subscriber growth across our core established channels— including Google Ads, Meta, and Apple Search Ads— while pioneering expansion into other promising new channels like TikTok Ads and Creator/Affiliate Partnerships. This role is an opportunity to directly shape how millions of readers discover SuperSummary, combining analytical rigor with hands‑on creative experimentation to drive sustainable growth and ROAS improvements across channels.

You'll work cross‑functionally with our Product, Content, and Analytics teams to develop sophisticated, highly-targeted campaigns that reach students, educators, book club members, and lifelong learners wherever they are. The ideal candidate thrives on experimentation, stays ahead of platform changes, and can balance immediate performance goals with long-term brand building.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage and optimize daily paid media budgets and campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, Apple Search Ads, and other channels to hit CAC and ROAS targets

  • Build and refine audience segments, bidding strategies, and attribution models to improve efficiency across the funnel
  • Own the performance marketing budget , allocating resources across channels based on incrementality and strategic priorities
  • Run in-depth analyses on website/app engagement, conversion funnel performance, and A/B test performance for paid ads traffic to better understand opportunities for improvement
  • Report on performance to leadership with clear insights and recommendations for optimization
  • Stay current on platform updates , industry trends, and competitive landscape to identify new opportunities

Sample Projects

  • Google Ads deep dive: run AI-powered analyses on our existing strategy to identify and test new keyword/targeting strategies, copy and creative improvements, and bid optimizations
  • TikTok pilot program : Collaborate with our Content team to build SuperSummary's presence on TikTok from scratch, testing BookTok creator partnerships, spark ads, and in‑feed video to establish benchmarks and scale strategy
  • Landing page optimization : Work with Product and Design to build and test dedicated landing pages for key campaigns, improving conversion rates across channels
  • App Store Optimization: Test improvements to our mobile app marketing strategy (new keywords, descriptions, images, etc.) to improve the performance of our app-focused campaigns

Who You Are

  • 4-7+ years of performance marketing/paid media experience at high‑growth companies with particular expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads
  • Proven track record of scaling high‑volume paid channels (via both web and mobile app‑based products) while maintaining or improving efficiency metrics

About Daydream

Daydream is building the Hugging Face of real-time, interactive video AI: a powerful, open-source platform and vibrant community of developers, researchers, and creatives working together to advance the next generation of cutting-edge AI models and interactivity.

The Product

Daydream’s real time video AI & community platform includes:

  • The leading interactive AI platform for Touch Designer and StreamDiffusion
  • The leading knowledge base & community hub for real time AI and world models
  • A community of over 2,000 creative technologists, builders, and applied researchers

Daydream is a part of Livepeer, powering interactive live streaming for a global customer base, from top 15 global companies to world famous festivals like Burning Man.

The Role

We are looking to hire an execution-focused Product Marketing Manager to join our ever growing marketing team. Initially, the role would involve helping us understand and connect with our users, crafting the story of the product, producing content, developing launch plans and coordinating those launches, and helping with partnerships enablement.

What you’ll do

Craft the Story: Develop clear, compelling narratives around our product, features, and vision.

Launch & GTM: Plan and execute product and feature launches. Collaborate on distribution strategies across channels like X, Discord, Reddit, newsletters, community platforms, and earned media.

Content Production: Write or coordinate blog posts, landing pages, technical explainers, and demo content that resonates with our users.

Partnerships Enablement: Create decks, one-pagers, and case studies to support partnership and sales efforts.

Measure & Iterate: Track engagement, growth, and feedback to continuously refine messaging, positioning, and marketing strategies.

Vendor Management: Collaborate with external agencies, freelancers, and partners to scale marketing output efficiently. This includes drafting clear briefs, setting expectations and timelines, reviewing deliverables, and ensuring work is aligned with brand voice, quality standards, and strategic goals.

Reporting: Create regular performance reports on campaigns, launches, and content, providing insights and recommendations to guide strategic decisions.

About you

Must-have experience

Background in AI or Developer Tools: You’ve marketed a product in the AI space and can speak the language of developers and technical audiences.

Strong Execution Skills: You move fast, prioritize ruthlessly, and deliver high-quality work on time.

Excellent Storyteller: You know how to distill complex ideas into clear, compelling messages.

Creative & Curious: You're excited to experiment, iterate, and help shape a new product in an emerging category.

Open Source Familiarity: Bonus points if you’ve worked with or marketed open-source projects before.

Remote Collaboration Skills: You’re self-directed, organized, and great at async communication in a distributed team.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Base Salary: We will offer a competitive market rate based on experience and location.
  • Token package: Competitive token package with a 3-year vesting schedule
  • Employee Stock Option Plan: Competitive ESOP with 4-year vesting and a 1-year cliff.
  • Annual Adjusted Salaries: Every January, we review and adjust pay.
  • Holidays: 25 vacation days per year plus any national holidays. A day off on your birthday, because you deserve to celebrate! (If it falls on a weekend, take another day off that week.)
  • Learning and Development Budget: 2,000 USD per year to invest in courses, certifications, or workshops to grow in your role.
  • Insurance: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance in applicable locations.
  • Pension: Company pension contributions in applicable locations.
  • Equipment: Choose a laptop of your preference and anything you need for a comfortable work setup (we’ll purchase it for you)
  • Home Office Upgrades: 300 USD every two years to refresh your workspace at home.
  • Flexible Working: Flexible hours to support work-life balance.
  • Annual Company Retreat: Once a year, we fly the whole company to an exciting global location for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun—all expenses covered
  • Team Meetups: Each team comes together in person once a year to build trust, spark ideas, and share meaningful moments that go beyond the screen.
  • Subscription Gift: 250 USD per year to spend on a personal subscription of your choice.
  • Work Anniversary Rewards: At Livepeer, we love recognising your journey. As you reach 3, 4, 5 years and beyond, you'll be celebrated with gift card rewards.
  • Celebrate Life’s Big Moments: Whether it’s a wedding, a new baby, or another major milestone, we’ll mark the occasion with a celebration gift.
  • Referral Bonus: Refer great talent to Livepeer and earn 100 LPT tokens when they’re hired and successfully complete their probation.
  • Latest Tech: Work with cutting-edge AI and the latest technologies alongside an innovative and entrepreneurial team.

DevOps Analyst

Remote

Overview

We are seeking a skilled DevOps Analyst to join our technology group, focusing on production support and management of technical environments. This role will support the day‑to‑day operations of applications, manage infrastructure projects, and collaborate with cross‑functional teams to ensure smooth development, testing, and release cycles. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise, excellent organizational skills, and a proactive approach to problem‑solving.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and maintain various environments (database, web, and application servers) for development, testing, and releases, including scheduling and coordinating environment refreshes/resets.
  • Create and manage Azure DevOps releases, overseeing deployment pipelines, builds, and associated tasks.
  • Lead infrastructure projects, such as server upgrades, assessing and addressing impacts on applications and users, including Disaster Recovery testing (scheduling, overseeing, and documenting).
  • Collaborate with onshore, nearshore, and offshore development, infrastructure, cloud, security, and support teams to perform periodic maintenance tasks, such as password rotations and SSL certificate renewals.
  • Investigate bug causes, coordinate fixes, and support testing with cross‑functional teams.
  • Create and manage tickets for production support, ensuring compliance with SOX and regulatory procedures through coordination with Change and Release control teams.
  • Communicate with application users regarding system status and specific issues they raise.
  • Develop a deep understanding of applications and business processes to create and execute test and release plans.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for applications, processes, and projects.
  • Identify and recommend process improvements and workflow automations.
  • Research and propose solutions leveraging existing and emerging technologies.
  • Maintain a workboard (e.g., in Asana) to keep management and project leaders informed of status, efforts, and issues.
  • Attend scheduled meetings and work primarily on a US East Coast schedule (ET 09:00 – 17:00), with occasional availability outside regular hours for critical production support.

Required Skills

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure DevOps, particularly in deployment processes (pipelines, builds, repository management, version review, and error handling).
  • Strong understanding of server and network architecture.
  • Knowledge of web development tools and architectures.
  • Familiarity with relational database concepts and structures.
  • Experience with development, testing, and release cycles in an Agile environment.
  • Excellent communication skills for engaging with end‑users and development teams.
  • Strong organizational skills to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Self‑motivated with a proactive approach to initiating, pursuing, and resolving issues.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to precision.
  • Comfortable reading and writing requirements and test scripts.
  • Willingness to work outside regular business hours for critical production support when needed.

Recommended Skills

  • Proficiency in MSSQL (T‑SQL).
  • Experience with Slack (Workflow Builder, etc.).
  • Familiarity with Asana (Workflow Builder, etc.).
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow.
  • Proficiency in PowerShell scripting.
  • Experience with Office 365, including Excel macros.
  • Familiarity with MS PowerApps.
  • Experience with ETL tools such as Alteryx.
  • Bilingualism (Spanish and English) to support communication with a global workforce and user base.
  • Familiarity with the broadcast industry and signal distribution technologies.
  • Experience with automation and workflow/process tools.
  • Development experience with object‑oriented programming languages (e.g., Java, Visual Studio, .NET, C#).

Work Schedule

  • Primary work hours: US East Coast schedule (ET 09:00 – 17:00).
  • Occasional availability outside regular hours for critical production support.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Customer Success - Team Manager.
To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to help our team of Customer Success Managers across regions. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success and an obvious passion for new technologies. Ideally, you have been a Customer Success Manager at one point in your career and naturally evolved to a leading position.
You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you are to provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. You are comfortable dealing with ambiguity and quickly adapt to changes. You seek collaboration with other teams to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility is to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work hand-in-hand with the Head of Customer Success.
CSMs engage a diverse customer base and follow diverse CSM motions to provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer. The right candidate would adapt to this diversity and bring broad experience to the team.
Location: This is a globally remote role

Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive upsells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.
  • Customer interactions and support to your team: you resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention. You work closely with your team members to ensure timely resolution.
  • Team management: you are passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. You are ready for regular performance reviews with team members. While your help in identifying areas for improvement is key, you are asked to celebrate excellence, recognise your team's achievements, and set goals for individual growth within the team.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.
  • Documentation and reporting: you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.

  • Excellent academic results at school and university
  • Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM

We work with networking silicon providers to optimize Ubuntu and related applications for their ASICs, boards and appliances.
